environment: conditioned by the following syllable (retracted unless a front vowel follows)
notes: A fronted [a] and a retracted [ɑ] contrast on the surface before a final consonant, but are 'conditioned variants of a' in base forms: fronted before a front vowel (i, e, æ, ə) in the next syllable, retracted elsewhere (pp. 26-27, 33; PR 32).
